experiment.question: Does the strict pinned Shiu/FlyWire-v630 model reproduce the archived bilateral prediction that unilateral 200 Hz sugar-GRN activation drives contralateral MN9 more strongly than ipsilateral MN9?
experiment.hypothesis: For both the archived right-hemisphere and left-hemisphere sugar-GRN sets at 200 Hz, the contralateral MN9 firing-rate distribution exceeds the ipsilateral MN9 distribution and the whole-neuron mean-rate vector remains highly concordant with the archived Edmond V3 reference.
experiment.falsifier: Either hemisphere fails structural 30-trial execution, fails contralateral > ipsilateral MN9 with one-sided Mann-Whitney p < 0.05, retains less than 50% of the archived MN9 mean-difference effect, or has archived-vs-rerun whole-rate-vector Spearman rho below 0.98.
experiment.model: Upstream Brian2 leaky-integrate-and-fire model in pinned model.py under the strict SCI-R00 environment; default_params unchanged except explicit r_poi=200 Hz for this figure-specific condition.
experiment.task: Run two independent 30-trial 1000 ms conditions: archived 21-neuron right sugar-GRN set at 200 Hz and archived 10-neuron left sugar-GRN set at 200 Hz; compare homologous MN9 responses and whole-neuron mean-rate vectors to archived Edmond V3 raw outputs.
controls: Ipsilateral homologous MN9 is the within-condition comparator for each unilateral sugar-GRN stimulation.
Edmond V3 raw 200 Hz outputs are an external frozen reference, not a source of random seeds for the rerun.
fixed_conditions: FlyWire v630 bundled inputs and their R00-verified hashes
strict R00 environment with Python 3.10.11 and Brian2 2.5.1
r_poi=200 Hz explicitly; no dependence on tutorial default frequency
right condition uses the archived 21 right-hemisphere sugar-GRN FlyWire IDs
left condition uses the archived 10 left-hemisphere sugar-GRN FlyWire IDs
no silenced neurons; no second excitation class
all default model parameters other than r_poi remain unchanged
record n_proc, platform, wall time and peak process-tree RAM as execution parameters
metrics: process exit/exception status and 30 trial identifiers per hemisphere
MN9 left/right per-trial spike counts and mean firing rates
contralateral minus ipsilateral MN9 mean-rate difference for each hemisphere
one-sided Mann-Whitney U test for contralateral > ipsilateral MN9 for each hemisphere
effect-retention ratio: rerun MN9 mean difference divided by archived mean difference
Spearman rho between archived and rerun whole-neuron mean-rate vectors over the union of nonzero FlyWire IDs with missing rates filled as zero
top-200 mean-rate Jaccard as a secondary non-gating diagnostic
output bytes/SHA-256, wall time and peak process-tree RAM
experiment.compute_budget: Two 30-trial whole-brain runs. Use a resource-safe recorded n_proc; stop on resource exhaustion. No frequency sweep, silencing experiment, or topology-null comparison is authorized by this manifest.
experiment.analysis_plan: For each condition compute 30 per-trial spike counts for contralateral and ipsilateral MN9, one-sided Mann-Whitney U (alternative=greater), archived effect retention, and whole-neuron mean-rate Spearman correlation against the frozen 200 Hz Edmond reference. Success is conjunctive across both hemispheres. The project-defined replication tolerance is >=50% archived MN9 effect retention and rho>=0.98; these thresholds are frozen before rerun execution. Absolute mean rates, top-200 Jaccard and performance are secondary diagnostics and cannot rescue a failed primary gate.
experiment.success_criterion: PASS only if both hemisphere conditions complete all 30 trials with structurally valid output; each has contralateral MN9 mean > ipsilateral mean with one-sided Mann-Whitney p<0.05; each retains at least 50% of its archived MN9 mean-difference effect (right reference 30.3333333333 Hz; left reference 12.6666666667 Hz); and each archived-vs-rerun whole-rate-vector Spearman rho is >=0.98. Source/data/reference hashes must remain unchanged and repository/source cleanliness postconditions must pass.
confounds: Final Nature panel assignment says main Figure 1c used left sugar GRNs and Extended Data Figure 1d used right; the preprint/archive notebook names Figure 1 as right and Figure S1 as left. This R02 freezes the bilateral 200 Hz laterality prediction rather than panel identity.

Archived and pinned model.py bytes differ, but numeric defaults and core simulation functions create_model/poi/run_trial/silence are AST-identical; remaining observed differences are comments/docstrings/print wording.
PoissonInput is stochastic and no explicit upstream seed is frozen; exact spike hashes are not expected.
Brian2 may use NumPy code generation on this host because MSVC Cython compilation is unavailable; this is a performance confound.
This experiment does not compare biological topology against artificial/randomized controls.
FlyWire-v630 commercial-use/redistribution clearance is not established by this experiment.

reference_evidence.source_dataset: doi:10.17617/3.CZODIW, Edmond Drosophila Brain Model V3

non_claims: This preregistration does not assert that R02 has run.
A future R02 PASS would reproduce only the frozen bilateral 200 Hz MN9 laterality prediction in this model/data lineage.
It would not establish biological validity, connectome-topology superiority, embodied-controller usefulness, commercial clearance, or game value.
